title: 秋華賞の後に・冠、掲げて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober carves her name into history after completing the Triple Tiara with an outstanding performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though the audience's cheers threaten to move her to tears, Mejiro Dober presents herself in a refined manner befitting a queen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Mejiro Dober thanks me again for believing in her, and the two of us take our first step toward our new future!
